title: Ben Webster's influences; Benny Carter born in New York
summary: Collins thinks Ben sounded like Benny Carter on alto and notes Carter was a native New Yorker.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: I really don't know. I've heard --

Well, I think he was an original, but you know, I think if Ben played alto he would sound like Benny Carter. Now, I really believe if he -- I don't know who influenced whom, but if he played alto he would play like Benny Carter.
They both came -- they both (inaudible). Kansas City? came from

No, no, no. Benny Carter was born in New York City. As a matter of fact the last time we were there I was there with him with this Marie Huldau. We did some concerts there. We drove by the apartment, wherever he was born, and he was pointing it out to us. Somewhere Somebody on 10th Avenue, somewhere over there. So -- no, he's a native New Yorker.
Like Russell Procope showed (Unintelligible) told me of the place that he was born in New York.
